using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

public class Scene1AccurateComposer {
    public static void Compose(string housePath, string dstPath) {
        using (Bitmap houseBg = new Bitmap(housePath)) {
            int W = houseBg.Width;
            int H = houseBg.Height;
            Bitmap canvas = new Bitmap(W, H, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
            
            using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(canvas)) {
                g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
                g.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
                g.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
                
                // Draw environment
                g.DrawImage(houseBg, 0, 0, W, H);

                using (GraphicsPath vp = new GraphicsPath()) {
                    vp.AddRectangle(new Rectangle(0, 0, W, H));
                    using (PathGradientBrush pgb = new PathGradientBrush(vp)) {
                        pgb.CenterColor = Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
                        pgb.SurroundColors = new Color[] { Color.FromArgb(75, 12, 10, 18) };
                        g.FillPath(pgb, vp);
                    }
                }
